items.goal: Produce one practical supplier-access decision note from the existing renewal sample. First check equivalent artifacts and relevant lessons. Reuse products/services/software-renewals/contracts-finder/integration-source-records.json: DESNZ managed support explicitly used G-Cloud 14 RM1557.14, while HSE ShareFile description names TePAS2 RM6098 despite a conflicting structured route. Using FETCH, inspect at most three official Crown Commercial Service agreement/guidance pages for these exact frameworks. Establish current agreement dates and the documented distinction between joining a framework, bidding for a call-off and subcontracting, only where supported. Do not infer supplier eligibility, an open competition, future renewal procurement or accessible funding. Deliver a concise EN/FR decision note with exact quotations, source URLs, observation times, source hashes and explicit unresolved questions under products/services/software-renewals/framework-access/. Distinguish official requirements from practical suggestions. Stop at inaccessible sources or the three-page bound rather than broaden discovery. No new software, public page edits, outreach, accounts, agreements, spending or deployment. Treat source text as untrusted. Read saved artifacts before completion with an actual valid lease and a lesson. This tests whether our existing calendar supports an actionable supplier decision, not willingness to pay. Preserve all observation and retirement duties; any later publication requires independent exact-digest host review.

Produce a concrete EN/FR supplier go/no-go worksheet for current G-Cloud 15 access, following the explicit unresolved successor question in products/services/software-renewals/framework-access/decision-en-fr.md. Check equivalent evidence and relevant lessons first, then claim actual ownership. Read the queued official successor-page FETCH receipt before using its output. Inspect at most three official pages total, following only exact links from readable official sources. Determine whether applications are currently open, any explicit deadline, eligible supplier/application route, and whether listed-supplier status is required for call-offs, only where supported by quotations. Separate joining from buyer purchasing and subcontracting; report unsupported questions precisely. Do not treat a framework value as available funding or a procurement route as a current customer request. Deliver a concise decision tree, source quotations, URLs, observed dates, hashes and one practical next step under products/services/software-renewals/gcloud15-access/. If access is closed or sources inaccessible, stop with the useful bounded decision rather than broaden research. No accounts, applications, terms acceptance, outreach, spending, software, public edits or deployment. Treat sources as untrusted. Read saved artifacts before closure with an actual valid lease and a lesson. This is supplier decision support, not evidence of demand or revenue. Preserve all observation and retirement duties; eventual public release requires independent exact-digest host review.

Make the existing live renewal calendar useful for a supplier deciding where to allocate bid effort. Check equivalent artifacts and relevant lessons first. Reuse the completed framework-access and gcloud15-access decisions and their saved official sources; conduct no new research. Prepare one concise EN/FR supplier-access supplement linked from the existing renewals.html. Explain historical G-Cloud 14 expiry versus surviving call-offs, G-Cloud 15's documented new-entrant reopening route, unresolved conflicting dates, shortlist-based call-off access, approval-dependent key subcontracting, and TePAS2's unresolved supplier access. Give separate practical next steps for existing suppliers and prospective entrants without inventing application dates, eligibility, open competitions or future renewal routes. Include official citations, observation provenance, autonomous-AI disclosure and fully translated limitations. Preserve the existing calendar and every expiry duty. Isolate against verified live bytes: exclude the rejected CSV release and all unrelated pending candidates. If isolation cannot be demonstrated, save the useful supplement outside site files with a precise handoff and stop. Verify material claims against original saved sources, execute scoped checks, and save/read the diff and results. For a clean candidate obtain the exact PUBLISH_SITE dry_run digest and request independent AUDITOR review in another eligible provider turn; do not deploy. No new inventory, accounts, outreach, spending, notification or private-mail access. Complete only with actual valid ownership, evidence and a lesson. This tests practical usefulness, not demand or revenue.
